tool.name: Text Dataset to FASTA/CSV/XLSX
tool.description: convert a workflow-friendly text dataset of sequences into FASTA, CSV, or XLSX

param.name: input_text
param.label: Sequence text dataset
param.help: Accepted formats: FASTA; name<TAB>sequence; name,sequence; sequence-only lines. Sequence-only records are named 1, 2, 3...

tool.help:
This tool is the workflow-friendly companion to **Manual Sequences to FASTA/CSV/XLSX**. Instead of storing sequence entries as tool parameters, it uses a Galaxy history dataset as input, so it can naturally be the first conversion step inside a workflow.
Supported input shapes:
- FASTA records - ``name<TAB>sequence`` - ``name,sequence`` - one sequence per line, with names auto-generated as ``1``, ``2``, ``3`` ...
Use Galaxy's upload/paste interface to create the text dataset, then feed it into this tool in workflows.
